clues.title: THE PINE PLAQUE
clues.caption: The pineapple and PINE name point to the fund's pseudonymous founder. This invented plaque is a storytelling clue, not a documented dedication at a particular water point.

clues.title: THE BITCOIN CASE
clues.caption: The Bitcoin symbol connects the technician's everyday tools to a cryptocurrency-funded gift. It links an abstract asset to practical work without identifying Pine or a real field team.
